items.text: Crabs and jellyfish now navigate more reliably: added step height to stop cliff glitches, obstacle‑avoidance raycasts, fixed leg‑speed issues, and switched jellyfish water checks to a batched system.
Frog and other critter behavior tuned – jump glitches and dead‑animation stalls fixed, frog size increased by 20%, and health lowered (frogs 60, rabbits 100) for better balance.
Livestock keep pace with you when led, eliminating lead breaks and long waiting times.
Floating animal glitches resolved and bulls now correctly stop looking at lost targets.
Livestock vendor inventory refined: respects game mode (no guns in Primitive), duplicate Custom SMG removed and replaced with a Thompson submachine gun.

Livestock sales revamped – low‑quality turrets removed, high‑end sales now include basic BP fragments, Thompson, Custom SMG, Python, and HC Revolver; wool now contributes roughly 75 % of livestock revenue.
Water sources (sinks) can now be moved between rooms without issue.
Biofuel generators run quietly and function correctly: idle noise eliminated and stirrer positioned for reliable operation.
Ladder rotations corrected to align properly with structures.
Open fence gates added to the ranch and large barn, providing easier access to the vendor area.

items.text: Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.

2026-09-27.summary:
### Livestock & Animals
- Livestock vendor auction now pauses if the wool stack size changes mid‑offer; keep your inventory matching the original size or the sale will time out.
- Livestock are now docile in safe zones, and the NPC livestock buyer correctly handles cases where livestock die or flee during conversation.
- Animals no longer seek out food; food‑sensing disabled for animals that don’t need it, fixing odd food‑related behavior.
- Cows can no longer graze on ice or sand, preventing them from wasting resources on unsuitable terrain.

### Structures
- Animal fence gate durability reduced from 500 HP to 100 HP, making them easier to break.

### UI & Quality of Life
- Country tag now respects streamer mode, hiding the player's country when the setting is enabled.

2026-09-26.summary: No notable player-facing changes were identified in the latest development commits.
